summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P SmallCap Industrials ETF (PSCI) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Small Cap 600 / Industrials index. The fund tracks a cap-weighted index of industrial stocks selected from the S&P SmallCap 600. PSCI was launched on Apr 7, 2010 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: PSCI is an equity ETF with a total of 97 individual holdings. The top holdings are Paycom Software stock at 2.76%, Arcosa at 2.34%, Federal Signal at 2.28%, Armstrong World Industries at 2.26%, and Zurn Elkay Water Solutions at 2.24%.
